items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Myron Bachman studio' where a recording took place, but the interviewee does not mention Myron Bachman personally or describe a relationship.

If the tape which I intend to prepare were played continuously, your performance of April 1949 with the Cakewalking Babes, which was recorded at the Myron Bachman studio on Carmen Avenue, just off Broadway about 5200 north, would have been heard, and we'll go back to a discussion of the Victory Club. Do you remember other people at the Victory Club besides your group, and these we've named, do you ever run into anybody else there?
Yeah, there were people who used to drop in and play. I'm trying to think of...
